exposure: Arterial hypotension during the first 24 hours of life (minMAP24)
cohort: The study included 4907 very low birth weight (VLBW) infants with a gestational age less than 32 weeks.
finding: Hypotension during the first 24 hours of life is independently associated with a higher rate of intraventricular haemorrhage, bronchopulmonary dysplasia, and mortality in VLBW infants.
